_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Sideways coil with F&G 48, calm VIX, and no ETF-flow or funding breaker; base rate favors HOLD until a shock exits the 40-55 band.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit Complacency/HOLD medium; narrative no forward call (low conf stub)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 40-55 and 30d momentum stays a small drift without ETF-flow or funding shock
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound with momentum positive and F&G through 60 (up), or flush drives funding negative and F&G below 35 (down)
